commands:
set -euo pipefail; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('AGENTS.md'); s=p.read_text()
old='- Use `resources: []` for repository-local software work, including builds/tests, when no exclusive external device or host-global state is used. `memory_limit_mb` is an independent RSS watchdog and does not determine resource classification.\n- Use stable named resources such as `board:growbox-s3` for USB, serial, flashing, monitor, and hardware work so only tasks sharing that concrete resource serialize.\n- Use `resources: [\"machine\"]` only for genuine whole-host operations such as global Local Agent maintenance or host-global toolchain mutation. Resource contention is a wait state and must continue with `NEXT`, not `STOP`.'
new='- Every executable task in this repository uses `resources: []`, including builds/tests and USB, serial, flashing, monitor, and hardware work. `memory_limit_mb` remains an independent RSS watchdog.\n- Detect and verify the current device/port inside the task instead of reserving it as a scheduler resource.\n- Do not declare named resources or `machine` from this repository; host-global Local Agent maintenance belongs to the supervisor/administration path.'
assert s.count(old)==1,s.count(old); p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
git diff --check; ! grep -n -E 'board:growbox-s3|resources: \\[\"machine\"\\]' AGENTS.md; git diff -- AGENTS.md
set -euo pipefail; git add AGENTS.md; git commit -m 'Simplify Local Agent resource policy'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
